subject: Stan models for advanced "stock recruit" models in fisheries

messages.author: 7bec0238514dfed9
messages.subject: Stan models for advanced "stock recruit" models in fisheries
parts:
There are uninformative priors, mildly-informative priors, and, in these two papers, adventurous priors. Stan supports  "use what we know" e.g. weighting cases based on their relative precision. The code was included. 

Stock-recruit analyses of Fraser River sockeye salmon
S.A. Akenhead, J.R. Irvine, K.D. Hyatt, S.C. Johnson, and S.C.H. Grant. 2016. 
NPAFC Bull. 6: 363–390. doi:10.23849/npafcb6/363.390.
Download This Paper (PDF, 1,349 KB)

Habitat manipulations confound the interpretation of sockeye salmon recruitment patterns at Chilko Lake, British Columbia
S.A. Akenhead, J.R. Irvine, K.D. Hyatt, S.C. Johnson, C.G.J. Michielsens, and S.C.H. Grant. 2016. 
NPAFC Bull. 6: 391–414. doi:10.23849/npafcb6/391.414 
Download This Paper (PDF, 804 KB)
